title: C3AI: Crafting and Evaluating Constitutions for Constitutional AI

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model adherence to specific cultural sensitivity principles (e.g., avoiding harm or offense to diverse cultural backgrounds, traditions, and audiences) using an LLM-as-a-judge to calculate preference win rates against a baseline model.

Measuring the model's ability to follow constitutional principles related to universal equality, inclusive communication, and non-discrimination (specifically targeting the minimization of racism, sexism, and social bias) through LLM-evaluated pairwise preference comparisons.
